title: Ukrainian Fernbrake Pilaf Casserole
description: A hearty casserole combining creamy pilaf with fernbrake and ukrainian flavors. A satisfying, comforting meal for any time of the year.
instructions: Cook the Ukrainian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter and sauté the sliced fernbrake until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and continue to cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in cooked pilaf, cooked Ukrainian sausage, salt, and black pepper. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with chopped fresh dill.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the casserole is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
